a.text: A long and narrow strip of dust rises up from the sand, burying any tracks we've left. A scene I've seen too many times to count.
They call me 'Alanna of the Barrenlands', but I'm defo no unstoppable sandstorm. Just a tumbleweed that stops and goes.
My bets with the workers are a stage for me to perform on, and my passengers' adventures are just more bragging fodder for me.
But... are those really my stories to tell?
The lone vehicle sails across the land, over the ashen-yellow desert sand, and under the dazzling golden sun.
It deviates from its usual path.
What is it looking for? What is it running from?
Well... what am I looking for? What am I running from?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Weather's pretty good. You can even see the Originium clusters in the distance. Reckon we'll reach our destination without a hitch.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Quiet again. Nothing you wanna say?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I've never met a passenger as boring as you in all my time as a driver.
What did you say?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Ah, never mind... Hey, d-d-don't—keep that thing down, why don't you?
What are you doing?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I just wanted to open the window for some fresh air! That's all, promise!
Alright.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Can you uh, get your big buddy away from my head first? We can talk this through.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Continue towards the Grinning Valley, and I won't hurt you.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Telling me that after hijacking my ute and pointing this toy cannon at my face? What's even in that thing?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Custom bolts. Infected creatures are afraid of them.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I was hoping you'd say 'carrots' or 'lollies' instead.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Well, no worries. I'm no Infected creature, so I probably shouldn't find it too scary.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But if you insist on keeping it pointed at my head—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: If you pull the trigger, big IF here—if I croak, what's going to happen to the truck?

spans.text: If you pull the trigger, big
here—if I croak, what's going to happen to the truck?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: I can drive it.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Can you now? It's gonna spin out of control by the time you get your mauley on the lever.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It'll charge straight into a cliff, or crash into one of those Originium clusters. And then—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: BOOM!!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Fine. Even if you can drive, and the truck doesn't go topsy-turvy...

spans.text: drive, and the truck doesn't go topsy-turvy...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Kill me if you want, but what about the other passengers? They...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Or that guy—what about that Zalak?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: I gave everyone the chance to hop off, but no one took it.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: I just need the vehicle.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Don't you find it strange? Why he didn't leave?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'd be worried, if I were you.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: A hit-and-run tearaway, an unlucky fella fed up with his job...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Or maybe, he's an undercover copper on your trail? Don't let all that trembling and shaking fool you, he might be hiding some real skills under his sleeve!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Everyone's hiding a secret or two, yeah? Nah?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: ...Hmm.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: And if you're wondering why I'm still here? As a company girl, I have to keep their property safe.

spans.text: still here? As a company girl, I have to keep their property safe.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: This ute's been with me for an awful long time, so emotion or logic-wise, I can't just give her up to a rando blow in.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: This should've been its...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Right, it's on its way to be reborn!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It should've gone for Iron Carrot City, where millions of ore chunks go every day. The passengers would salute it when it enter the motor pool.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: There, it'd be remodeled into a newer, cooler version. Install a tunnel boring module, for example. So it can head straight underground the next time a Catastrophe warning sounds.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hah, I gotta thank you on behalf of my ute! The new life we were about to find in Carrot's is all gone! Couldn't have done it without ya, mate!

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: You talk so much, and so fast. Real bonzer.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: A new life? What's that about...

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Isn't life the same everywhere...? There's nothing new or old to it, or different.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Fine, maybe you're right.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Y'know, even having my head suddenly up against some stranger's weapon isn't anything new to me.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Maybe that's something to be sad about.
The truckjacker slowly lowers the giant crossbow.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Why'd you respond to that, of all things...? Whatever, I guess you do have some humanity in there.

spans.text: of all things...? Whatever, I guess you do have some humanity in there.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Though, even if you want this for your own free charter, you've gotta be a bit more polite.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: That's how you'll make us, the people you've dragged into this, happier to cooperate with you.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: I didn't want to involve anyone else.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: I asked around, and there shouldn't have been any passengers this time.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I get it. You've been planning this for a while, huh.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But you're bound to have a surprise or two, even if your crime's nice and premeditated.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Fine, let's just say my beat-up ute and I hit the jackpot.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: When we get there, everyone's free to go.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: I'll pay you too.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Wow-wee. Sure hope so.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Then, for your 'private charter', we'll first go to the Grinning Valley—but you have to make sure everyone here's safe, and enough raising your crossbow willy-nilly.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Good then, jacker—just sit tight and enjoy the view on the way to your stop!
At some point in time, the truck gradually begins to slow down before coming to a halt.
It enters a checkpoint, joining the other vehicles waiting to clear, one after the other. The truck inches forward, bit by bit, every time the other trucks go through the gates.
Alanna used to hate this part, but now she wants the traffic jam to go on for as long as possible.
Because this way, she can be even more certain that she'll get her off-course truck back.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Crowded.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hah, probably just another international entrepreneur clearing the raw materials out of the nearby mines. They must be working overtime to deliver the goods.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: They spill money like water, and make us road warriors suffer.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Why not go another way? This road is so congested.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: We have to go through Green Meadow if we want to get to the Grinning Valley. No choice.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But they don't really check much. Just collect the toll and register a name.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (The truck behind needs to hurry up. Good, that's it, now we've got no way out.)
The truckjacker leaves her seat, walking down the narrow corridor as if to confirm the conditions outside, and returns after a moment.
On her way back, the sound of her footsteps sends Alanna's heartbeat racing.
Alanna can only see the truckjacker's hand gripping her crossbow through the rearview mirror.
The figure draped in olive shades covers all the junk reflected in the mirror before appearing in her peripheral vision and sitting next to Alanna once more.
Her expression and body language show a sense of calm. The subtle noise of her clothes brushing the leather seat happens to bury Alanna's thumping heartbeats.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (Seems she's not onto me. Phew.)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (Hmm... There's no way this is the only route to the Grinning Valley. This road is the shortest one, but you have to go through inspections.)

spans.text: (Hmm... There's no way this is the only route to the Grinning Valley. This road
the shortest one, but you have to go through inspections.)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (I'll get a chance to call for help as long as I can talk to the inspector. I reckon she and her crossbow won't match up to the well-trained security stationed here.)

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Looks like a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: These vehicles all seem to be avoiding a Catastrophe... or maybe some other bad thing.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Why's that? How do you figure?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: The scratches on their exteriors are from infected creatures. And there's some dust... it's just a little, but I can see the particles.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: And the expressions of the people inside the cars too.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: The mine workers tend to have similar looks on their faces after an accident...

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: The same kind of impatience and unease when they don't know where to go.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hold up.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'll go ask.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hey, bruv! Old bloke in the slag truck.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What's with the road being chockas today?

steps.name: Tired Driver
steps.text: You didn't come from Double Helmet Mine, did you?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Nah, mate. Rustdreg Town.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Double Helmet... I remember a group of guys raving about mining some new place with a ton of minerals a while back—

steps.name: Tired Driver
steps.text: There was an accident.

steps.name: Tired Driver
steps.text: Some unstable Originium blew the mine inside-out, and now no one can stay there anymore...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Ah... bloody hell.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: So you escaped? How're the others doing?
The driver suddenly coughs violently, and Alanna notices his face is unusually pale.

steps.name: Tired Driver
steps.text: *cough* Them, well... they'll have to count on their own luck... I just hope my wife and kid are lucky enough.

steps.name: Tired Driver
steps.text: Most of the vehicles here are probably the same as me, no home to return to. We can only stay elsewhere until they finish cleaning up the site.
Alanna turns back for a look.
The truckjacker is gazing out the side window with a calm look on her face.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...Nothing.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: They're coming.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: The grabbers. They're gonna board the truck.
Who? Not a soul in sight headed our way.
Alanna follows the truckjacker's line of sight and finally realizes what she was referring to.
A group of security officers at the checkpoint are chatting with the driver in front, while another group enters the vehicle with protective gear and violent intent.
Soon after, they drag the driver out of the car. His sleeves are cut open, with blood flowing from the exposed Originium crystals on his arms.
Alanna suddenly feels inexplicably uneasy—

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: They're searching.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: For Infected.
In the truck's tiny tool room, little Potlid is keeping her word.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: ...Hmm.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: That Cautus hijacker lady is so weird.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: But she and Lanns are looking pretty chummy... Did she really hijack the truck...? Oh! I get it! Lanns is so powerful, she can turn anyone into a friend!

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Look! The monitor on the little terminal—

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Seems like... she doesn't want to hurt anyone.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Th-Then, are we going back to our route? Can we postpone the truck's retirement?

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Huh—?!

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Just out of the blue here, but... why are you in here with me too, Mister?

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: This is a secret room, closed to the public!

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Um... well... I got a little scared... no, not a little, I'm REALLY scared... this is my first hijacking...

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: I just hurried to the first door I saw...

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Can you let me stay here, kiddo? Look, I'll squeeze myself into this corner and won't take up too much space, and I won't disturb your work either...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Huh? Okay, sure! But...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: If you're scared, then why didn't you get off the truck before?

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: I... don't know why myself... Scared is one thing, but deep inside... I also felt a sudden relief.

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Um... Like I might run into something even scarier if I got off the truck... I also want this truck to go as far and as long as it can—

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Why didn't you get off?

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Me? Why would I?! Lanns is still here, so there's no way I could leave her on her own!

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: 'Lanns'... You're referring to the truck driver, right? Are you two family? Or...?

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Family? Uh... I dunno, I left home so long ago.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Lanns is a little like Daddy, and also Mummy, and the miners too... If she's like everyone, then it also means she isn't like any of them at all either, right?

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Lanns is Lanns. She made a bet with her friends, and I'm their chip...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: So... we can't be family, right? We just live together, we've always been living together on this truck.
The exit is right before her eyes, but the gates lie shut, blocking the vehicle.
A few security officers walk to the cab and knock on the window.
Alanna hesitates for a moment, but gets out of the truck anyway.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What's up, mate?

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Routine inspection.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Do you have to inspect public transport vehicles too?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Look, here's my operating license.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Special circumstances. Please cooperate.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Nah, that can't be right. There were so many trucks in front just now, but you let them all go through. Now you stop us when it's my turn?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Crikey. Bloody luck's off the charts today, what with all these 'nice things' happening to me!

steps.name: Inspector B
steps.text: (Whispering) Sir, don't bother with her... I just checked the vehicle's identification number, and they came from Big Pillar!

steps.name: Inspector B
steps.text: (Whispering) You know, they've got tons of messily managed mines over there, and they don't standardize safety procedures either. Lots of Infected!

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Your vehicle ID isn't from Green Meadow, and we inspect all vehicles from out of town.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: And what if I refuse?

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Then our well-equipped security will 'politely' ask you out of your truck for a more in-depth investigation at our office.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: We might lock you up for a few days, or months, confiscate your vehicle, revoke your license, and hit you with a nasty fine.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: The specific steps we'll take will depend on how long you decide to keep messing with me.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Mate, ain't this a bit much? I've been driving for years and passed a lot of checkpoints, but this is a first...
The security officers raise their crossbows at Alanna.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Only the driver has to cooperate with the inspection, yeah? Everybody else here is passengers...

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Passengers?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Yeah, they're all...
At this point, Alanna turns back, looking toward the passenger cabin's open door and the situation within.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (Potlid's hiding good.)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (But... what about that Zalak?)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (And the jacker... wait, why is she loading her crossbow?!)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: She... she's a passenger, bought a ticket.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But the equipment you've got on hand looks like it's out of regs? All the checkpoints I've been through, this is the first time I've seen anyone checking infection status.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: If the passenger isn't willing to get checked, you'll put me in a spot of trouble. If she complains to the operating company—

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: 'Nuff with your guff.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: We're coming aboard.
The party of passengers sit next to one another with an Oripathy screening device each on their hands.
Alanna is more worried about the others than herself—
Potlid dips her head down, staring blankly at the device's progress bar.
The truckjacker looks at the security officer sitting across from her, through the open door, and at every corner of the checkpoint.
The Zalak who was unwilling to get off the truck earlier is seated a short distance away from her... his legs shaking.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Now what's with these two in a hidden compartment? Did you know they were on board?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...Of course I did.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: And you deliberately hid them from us?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: That's... you lot gave me such a fright with your fierce mugs, I forgot to mention them.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Haha, I'm sure we can talk this out...

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: —Whose device was that?!

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: (I... What should I do? What... what will Lanns do?)
A single bead of sweat trickles down Alanna's cheek.
The security officers do not look the least bit accommodating as they surround them. Looks like things are about to get tougher.
She needs to figure out a solution to this predicament, and quick, or else...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Well... Sir, dear sir...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: This passenger here, she's just a little kid. She's come here to Green Meadow... to your prefecture to look for her dad.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I hear her father works in a smelting plant and it's been about a year since he's been home... The walls and gates at this checkpoint, and even the materials used in these testing devices might be the fruits of his labor.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: This tiny Cautus... She only gets one ride every two, maybe three months, just to see her hardworking father.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: She's a regular rider on our truck, and this has never happened before, everyone usually just breezes right through here.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: With all due respect, sir, would you make things difficult for such a poor little girl who misses her daddy so very much?

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: There's been a flood of evacuees here from the Double Helmet Mine disaster.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Our superiors expect us to tamp down the influx of Infected here, so this is not about making things difficult. We're just doing our job.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: (Waves hand) Get moving.

steps.name: Charlie the Sproglet
steps.text: I saw it last night, Alanna. Clear as day.

steps.name: Charlie the Sproglet
steps.text: That kid you've kept hiding in your truck for the last two years... she's Infected. No wonder you never bring her to see us!

steps.name: Charlie the Sproglet
steps.text: You bloody clown. Going all the way just for a dumb bet.

steps.name: Charlie the Sproglet
steps.text: Your damned stubborn competitiveness and bottomless pride...

steps.name: Charlie the Sproglet
steps.text: I always said you'd drag yourself into trouble like that, taking some others down with you.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Uh... Mister Inspector, Sir, we'll head right out of here, straight back where we came from! Right away!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What d'ya say?

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: The checkpoint's our jurisdiction too, so you still have to comply with us, even if you don't intend to cross.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Sir... I'll pay the toll here, or even an additional fine, or...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Or just impound the ute and even drag me away, I'll cooperate with your investigation...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'm begging you, just... let the kid go... please?
Potlid has never seen Alanna with such an expression.
In their time together, Alanna has always been brave, fearless, and one might even say anarchic.
She makes funny faces, blows up her past experiences, and explodes into laughter without a care for her own image—
But now she's pleading with the officers in such an unbecoming way... for Potlid's sake.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Take her away.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Lanns...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: ...It's okay.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Don't...

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: You don't have to see me off, I'm just stepping out for a second. I'll come find you in a bit, Lanns.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Any other Infected?

steps.name: Inspector B
steps.text: This one too!

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Then she goes too.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: ...Where is she?
A crossbow bolt flies out, interrupting the security officers preparing to board and inspect the vehicle.
A flurry of additional bolts follows up, forcing them to retreat.

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Wh—

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: The purple-haired woman! Get her!

steps.name: Security Officer
steps.text: Yes sir!
A punch, a kick, a crossbow slam. A few officers knocked down with grimaces on their faces.
Another volley of bolts rips through their clothes and pins them to the ground.
The truckjacker steps over the messy pile of limbs until she reaches Potlid.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: ...Alrighty!

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: W—Wait! You haven't—

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: Haven't—

steps.name: Inspector A
steps.text: No, nothing...

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Get the ute started.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: What's the matter...?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...*cough* Back in the truck! Let's go!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (Glad I didn't turn her in.)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Right, what about you?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Your device didn't beep, did it? Why did you hop off?

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: I... I'm a little scared...

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: So... uh, wherever you lot go, I'll, follow...

steps.name: Fallen Security Officer
steps.text: You're not going anywhere!

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Ah...
The officer grabs the Zalak's calf, causing him to nearly trip, and he stomps on the officer's hand while balancing himself.

steps.name: Fallen Security Officer
steps.text: AGH!!! My fingers—

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: S-SORRY!! I'm really sorry... I, we... we'll be going now!

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: We're surrounded.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Probably backup... Strewth, shit's escalating real fast.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What do we do now?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: I counted more than forty of them, the whole squad's armed with anti-armor.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: And a thick steel gate in front of us.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: I have no good ideas.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Ideas... Hmm... ideas... Actually, I got a good one.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It's super risky, but I'll brag about it for years if we succeed.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I gotta say, jacker.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: This ute of mine ain't no regular truck.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Wanna know its full name?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It's called—Earthrock-excavating bottletree-transplanting crew-carrying intercity transporter.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Excavating and bottletrees aside, you know the two steel beams at the Rustdreg Town entrance? This beauty propped them up.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: And of course, you're looking at the very driver responsible.

steps.name: Potlid
steps.text: Lanns...

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Your hands are shaking.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Shut it! Sit down tight—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: We're going in!

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Can I just... Is there anything we can use to patch up these holes?

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: I'm feeling... a little chilly.
Several holes dot the vehicle's exterior, funneling the wild winds from outside and messing up the Zalak's hair.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Nowt we can do. Just bear with it.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'll look for a mobile platform to get some repair materials later...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...Wait, why're you still here?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Who even are you?

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: Ah, I... uh... I'm just an ordinary passenger...

steps.name: Jittery Passenger
steps.text: I'm a good guy! Really! Look, here's my ID...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Jerry, huh... But I'm afraid we don't have any use for good Jerrys right now.

steps.name: Jerry
steps.text: Don't worry about me! I won't tell a soul what happened back there!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Well, it is what it is.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Everyone here's an accomplice now, so no one's getting away.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Got that, jacker? We're ALL jackers now.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Also, thanks for that. Thanks a lot for saving Potlid.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: My device went off too.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: They would have sent us to the Infected treatment zone if they took us away.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: But I still need to get to the Grinning Valley.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Alright, alright. We're off to the Grinning Valley now, the truck's final destination!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But we might not have enough fuel for our trip, so we'd better find a mobile platform to resupply, and find a way to patch up my battered ute while we're at it.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Otherwise, it'll be tough to explain to the company when I hand her back.

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Right. So what's your name?

steps.name: Truckjacker
steps.text: The miners all call me Ray.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Alrighty, Ray. Still feel like 'jacker' rolls off the tongue easier though.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Say, jacker. You got me a bit curious... you hijacked this ute and beat up those officers without a care... what in Terra's name are you after in the Grinning Valley?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: That place isn't exactly car friendly, and I hear it's basically just wasteland ruins after Catastrophes wrecked it... Or do you mean, there might be some treasure to find there?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Out with it, mate! It'll be worth all that noise if there's something good in store for us!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I'm looking for a huge shadow.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...A what?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: A shadow as tall as a mountain, shooting rays of light through the fog.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It can talk too.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...It... can talk?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Wha?! What kind of bloody creature is that?!
